title: Prohibited Items
content:
Prohibited and Restricted Items

Before purchasing a product, confirm that it can be legally purchased, stored and shipped to your destination country.

Some products are completely prohibited, while others can only be shipped through specific routes or under special conditions.

Commonly Prohibited Items

Products that may not be accepted include:

  • Illegal drugs and controlled substances
  • Weapons, ammunition and explosives
  • Counterfeit currency
  • Hazardous chemicals
  • Radioactive materials
  • Live animals
  • Human remains
  • Illegal publications
  • Products prohibited by applicable laws
  • Items that present a serious transportation risk

Commonly Restricted Items

The following products may require special confirmation:

  • Batteries and power banks
  • Liquids and powders
  • Food and beverages
  • Cosmetics and skincare products
  • Medicines and medical products
  • Perfume and aerosols
  • Magnets
  • Electronic devices
  • Plants and seeds
  • Products containing alcohol
  • Branded or high-value products
  • Sharp objects
  • Items containing compressed gas

Whether an item can be shipped depends on the product specification, destination country and selected shipping route.

Customer Responsibility

Customers are responsible for confirming that products comply with local import laws.

If a restricted item arrives at the warehouse, Hiobuy may ask you to select another shipping route, return the product to the seller or arrange another permitted solution.

Related domestic shipping, return, storage or handling fees may apply.

When you are uncertain about a product, contact customer service with the product link and destination country before placing the order.
